pending.title: Unexplained corrections ({count})
pending.intro: A change was redone by hand after an assistant proposal, and nothing says whether it was wrong or the intent changed. Both look exactly the same in the JSON — only an answer tells them apart.
pending.placeholder: What was wrong, in one sentence — or “nothing, I changed my mind”

failed.title: Lessons unreadable
failed.body: {error} — the “Self-learning assistant” module may be disabled (Modules page). This is not an empty corpus: nothing can be shown while this call fails.

budget.title: At most six rules reach the prompt on each turn
budget.body: {active} served, {candidate} pending. A “pending” rule comes from a single incident and is never served: it activates on the second occurrence, or with a click here. The number of rules can grow at no cost — it is the number SERVED that is capped, chosen by the workflow's node types and then by the words of the question.

empty.failed: Nothing can be shown: see the warning above.
empty.none: Nothing learned yet — rules appear when an assistant proposal is corrected by hand, or refused then fixed.

assistantLessons.generalHelp: General rule: only surfaces through the words of the question.

export.title: Export the configuration
export.intro: Generates a JSON file with the n8n instances, export targets, environment mappings, monitors, settings (AI, monitoring, general), module state, finding exclusions, workflow groups and manual map links — to import on another instance of the platform. Workflows and their versions are not part of the export (they resync from n8n).

disabled.title: Export disabled on this installation
disabled.body: The file would contain, in plain text, the n8n API keys, GitHub / Drive tokens, Uptime Kuma password, AI provider keys and heartbeat tokens. Export is only available locally (CONFIG_EXPORT_ENABLED=1, set by docker-compose.override.yml), where the file never leaves the machine. Import below remains available.

export.includeSecrets: Include secrets (n8n API keys, GitHub / Drive tokens)
export.secretsWarning: The file will contain secrets in plain text: do not share it and delete it after import.

twoPasses.title: On a blank database, import in two passes
twoPasses.body: Monitors, exclusions, groups and manual links point to workflows: they are only restored once those are synced. 1) import (instances are created), 2) sync the workflows from the Instances page, 3) re-import the same file with “Merge” — the missing references reported below will reattach.
